title: The Echo Self
text: Each Scion meets themselves coming back the other way along the path. Older. Thinner. Carrying scars they do not have yet. The echoes look tired, and they look sorry, and each of them seems to have something they want to say.

options.label: Each Scion speaks with their older self, hoping to learn what is to come.

outcomes.text: Advice, from the one who knows how it goes. They take it to heart.
A warning, and it is not one they wanted, and it comes true in the telling.

options.label: Each Scion walks past their echo without a word. Some futures are better not heard.

outcomes.text: It does not look back. It never did, and now they know they never will.
